# Version 4.152.2
> **Reliable GPU failure propagation** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.202/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Reject unsuccessful GPU work** — Tracks task execution separately from success and propagates upload failures so affected draws are dropped instead of using stale buffers. Existing managed flush operations remain void. ([#5069](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5069), [#5117](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5117))
- **Windows HarfBuzz scanning compatibility** — Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged. ([#5121](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5121))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.202

Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.
